# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

Most of these picks come from WIRED's tests. The right one depends on how fast you want to charge and where it will sit.

| Pick | Best for | Price | iPhone speed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand | Best overall | $109 (about $98 on sale) | 15W |
| Nomad Stand One Max | Fastest, premium look | $169 | 25W |
| Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | Flat, out-of-sight charging | $130 | 25W |
| Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (25W) | Desk use plus travel | $129.99 | 25W |
| ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 | Fast charging with a cooling fan | about $100 | 25W |
| ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W) | Budget | about $40 on Amazon | 15W |

## My top picks

**Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (best overall).** WIRED's top pick is a chrome stand with a tilting iPhone pad. It supports landscape and StandBy mode, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods spot on the base. It has a 2-year warranty and a 36W power supply. [WIRED review with buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Nomad Stand One Max (fastest).** It charges at 25W and holds the iPhone at an angle that works in portrait or landscape. It's heavy enough to lift the phone off one-handed. There's no power adapter in the box, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter, $25). [WIRED review with buy link](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, 25W.** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It lifts the phone over 70mm and has a 160° hinge. It folds for travel, and the box includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs. At 399g it's heavier than rivals. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1.** It delivers 25W with an active cooling fan that has an off button for sleeping. It includes a 50W adapter. WIRED notes the plastic build feels less premium. Its price is $99.99, and ESR's store has a 30-day return window. [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) (affiliate link, so the retailer pays a commission at no cost to you). The listing site says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off in its cart test, but checkout has the final say.

**Budget option.** WIRED calls the 15W ESR Qi2 3-in-1 the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It's compact, and the Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit. WIRED says the newer 25W version is "far more expensive for very little gain." [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Things to check before buying

- **25W only applies to newer iPhones.** ESR says full 25W needs an iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max or 16 Plus on iOS 26. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W. Macworld and WIRED both say 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so Belkin's 15W is enough for many people.
- **AirPods case:** it must support wireless charging.
- **Fast charging:** Apple Watch fast charging needs Series 7 or newer.

My recommendation is the Belkin for a nightstand, the Nomad or Nimble if you want 25W, and the Satechi if you also travel.

Sources: [WIRED 3-in-1 chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/), [WIRED travel chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/), [Macworld Satechi review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html), [Dealectric ESR listing](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
